title: Warp figure plate
description: A technical-drawing figure frame: a 1px ink border, a title bar with a small code-bracket box on the left, a bracketed figure caption in mono (optionally between two rules) and a grid box on the right, then an inset ink frame over a faint dot grid holding a white, softly rounded card.
notes: tone soft swaps the ink frame for hairlines (for code panels)
card=false drops the white inner card so the content sits on the dot grid
name: warp-plate

props.name: caption
props.description: the caption in the title bar, shown in brackets, e.g. "fig. 1 — the floor"

props.name: rules
props.description: draw a rule on each side of the caption

props.name: tone
props.description: ink: solid 1px ink frames · soft: hairline frames and a muted caption

props.name: card
props.description: wrap the content in a white rounded card (otherwise it sits on the dot grid)

props.name: bare
props.description: drop the inset frame and dot grid: the content fills the plate under the title bar

props.name: innerClassName
props.description: classes for the inner card (padding, layout)
